definitions.explanation: The psychological process of encoding new information into memory. A technical term used in psychology and cognitive science, corresponding to the encoding stage of memory (as distinct from retention and recall).

examples.japanese: {記銘|きめい}{力|りょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: Learn methods to improve memorization ability.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧{記銘|きめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Memorization function can decline with age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プロセス→プロセス：11291_purosesu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{記銘|きめい}・⟦{保持|ほじ}→保持：05618_hoji⟧・⟦{想起|そうき}→想起：19296_souki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}けられる→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧。
examples.english: The memory process is divided into three stages: encoding, retention, and recall.

notes:
A psychology term combining {記|き} (record) and ⟦{銘|めい}→銘：24393_mei⟧ (inscribe, engrave). Refers specifically to the first stage of memory formation — taking in and encoding new information. Distinguished from ⟦{保持|ほじ}→保持：05618_hoji⟧ (retention) and ⟦{想起|そうき}→想起：19296_souki⟧ (recall) in memory research.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記銘|きめい}{力|りょく}: memorization ability
- {記銘|きめい}⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧: encoding impairment
- {記銘|きめい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to commit to memory
- {記銘|きめい}⟦{過程|かてい}→過程：02621_katei⟧: encoding process

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{記名|きめい}→記名：14862_kimei⟧: writing one's name — a homophone with different kanji and meaning
- ⟦{暗記|あんき}→暗記：01701_anki⟧: memorization by rote — an everyday word for memorizing, while {記銘|きめい} is more technical
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧: memory — the broader concept encompassing encoding, retention, and recall
